description:
The museum in Wœrth is devoted to the battle fought on 6 August 1870 during the Franco-Prussian War, also associated with the name Reichshoffen.

Uniforms, weapons, documents and paintings preserve different accounts of the engagement. A large diorama offers another way to understand the actions and movements that shaped the battle.

description:
The Musée de l’Abbaye in Saint-Claude opened in 2008 with collections shaped by the gifts of artists Guy Bardone and René Genis.

Their own works accompany paintings by other twentieth-century artists, especially French figurative painting from the 1920s to the 1980s. The collection reflects the personal relationships and artistic interests of its donors.
